[i]Erene 2nd RP event RP'ing[/i]

After noticing a disturbing trend of some sort of infection spreading in the western most part of Ostland, wich is a popular tourist destination for people interested in historical sites because of its many intermingling forts, fortifications and buildings together with many historical sites that are a mix of Nordiheimian and Hydronian arcitect styles mostly from the early 1700s, the local health service notified the nations Department of Health.

The infection/desiease was reported to have been so far found mostly in tourists and workers of the local tourist industry and seemed to potentialy be some kind of brain infection based on the fact that the patients exibited symptoms of 'severe headache', 'problems sleeping linked to the severity of the headache' and signs of increasing delirium.
Their report also informed that there had most likely allready been fatalities.

Because of this the department of health sendt people from the 'Agentcy of Critical Disease Investigation and Research' (or ACDIR) to investigate the report with "fastest possible haste".
They also informed the Nordiheimian council about situation.

The Nordiheimian council as a cautionary measure informed the local goverments of Olia and Nordland about the situation and that they should look carefully if someting similar was unfolding in their areas.

((This RP is internal for the time being))

[b]emergency meeting[/b]
[i]after reports of an unknown virus surfaced in the port cities the goverment is holding an emergency meeting in the capital. Prime minister Anthonie Vuijk enters the room and looks around He looks around, sees that everyone is present, and sits down. Anthonie then starts talking,[/i] "gentlemen we have a serious problem now. A new virus has emerged in the country and reports say a few hundred people already died or are in critical condition. Any ideas how to respond?" [i]The minister of health, jacob vink then responds,[/i] "i suggest we will declare a state of emergency and put a lockdown into place before the virus spreads further and destroys parts of our population." the other ministers start to think and some agree while others don't. After 30 minutes of debate Anthonie Vuijk says, "i have to agree with what Jacob says here. I Will send the proposal to the king for him to make it official." [i]Jacob Vink nods and leaves the room to immediately start writing the proposal to the king.[/i]

With nearly 200 people infected and 17 dead so far, the Bobian National Health Service has contacted the government saying there may be a disease spreading. 

The disease has primarily been found in patients from the Capital city and the west coast. These areas are are the most popular tourist attractions nationwide and is leading to concerns from the civilian populace. 

During a quick chat between a workers at docks both on Bobian Territory and foreign territory it has been worked out as some kind of Virus outbreak seemingly affecting the brain and lungs majority of the time. 
One example was between workers of Nordiheim and Bob where both mentioned a disease spreading through popular tourist destinations and causing very strong headaches.

It has been given two names within Bob. Scientists and professionals call it: Llyndorran NeuroPulmonic Fever or The Gift as it's known to most people.

[spoiler=[b]Hydronia-EDU Peace negotiations - Day 1 update[/b]]
On the first day of negotiations, not much was achieved. Both sides agreed to deescalation as part of a peace deal, allowing Kaiserreich troops to withdraw safely, however when the Hydronians attempted to negotiate reparations, the Kaiserreich refused, proposing that instead, hochdeutsch companies be allowed to operate within Hydronia to rebuild its defence and infrastructure. This proposal was swiftly rejected by the Hydronians, leaving negotiations at a standstill for now.
[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Condemnation[/b]]
Hydronia has fiercely condemned the Technokratisches Kaiserreichs attack on the Enkian Theocracy. The government has repeatedly emphasised that is the reason THEP deemed intervention in western Elyser necessary, to preserve the sovereignty of all nations and to protect their people. Hydronia has further increased its independent sanctions on the Kaiserreich and has motioned a vote for THEP as a whole to do the same. Additionally, Hydronia has threatened to walk out of peace negotiations with the Kaiserreich unless they end their attacks on Enkia within 3 days.
[/spoiler]
